The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Prime Poultry Pilafs are [[Meal]]s that are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Bird Thigh]], [[Hylian Rice]], a [[Bird Egg]], and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These Pilafs are a favorite in the [[Region]] of [[Gerudo (Region)|Gerudo]], and the rice used permeates the savory taste of the poultry. Link can add a fifth Ingredient to the Cooking Pot when making Prime Poultry Pilaf, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. If they're eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. These meals will completely replenish and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. Consuming them will restore part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. Link can eat them to have his movement speed increased. * '''Hearty Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredient. Link's attack power will be boosted when he eats these pilafs. * '''Sneaky Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredient. When eaten, they will increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. Eating these pilafs will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Prime Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The rice permeates the savory taste of the poultry in this Gerudo-region favorite.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. They will grant Link a boost to his [[Defense]] if he consumes them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Prime Poultry Pilaf returns in {{TotK}}. It is made using the same [[Recipe]] it had in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Bird Thigh]] with a [[Bird Egg]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Hylian Rice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Curry Pilaf * Food * Gourmet Poultry Pilaf * Poultry Pilaf }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
